What is caste really like inside an IIT campus?

In this clip, Santosh Sir shares his own experience of studying at IIT and talks about classroom interactions, student groups, elections and the question of caste-based discrimination on campus.

Did he personally experience caste discrimination? Did he see it happening around him?

A candid conversation based on what he actually observed during his time at IIT Roorkee.

Welcome to the self-discovering episode of The Ranveer Show where spiritual guide Maa Gyaan Suveera shares her profound insights on self-realization, spiritual practices, and divine consciousness. Based in Rishikesh, Maa Gyaan discusses her journey, the power of mantra chanting, and the role of Guru Tattva in overcoming life's challenges. 

She explores deep questions like ‘Who am I?’ and how spiritual practices can dissolve the ego, leading to higher states of awareness and inner peace. This episode is perfect for anyone seeking spiritual growth and self-discovery.  I hope you enjoyed this episode and let me know your thoughts in the comments below.

snippet.description:
Are your PSIR answers actually answering what UPSC is asking?

In this lecture, Chandan Kumar Sir breaks down the common answer writing mistakes that aspirants often make and how to avoid them.

From understanding the demand of the question to improving structure, presentation and analytical depth, this session focuses on what can make your PSIR answers more effective for UPSC Mains.

If you are preparing for PSIR Optional for UPSC CSE 2027, this session can help you rethink the way you write your answers.

Enrollment Open in PSIR Optional Mentorship Program for UPSC CSE 2027:https://www.levelupias.com/courses/upsc-cse-psir-mentorship-program/
Call at 8826496658

PSIR Mentorship Program 2027

* 18 Tests: 16 Sectional Tests + 2 Full Length Tests
* Test Discussion Lectures with detailed discussions and model answers
* Test Evaluation within 10 days
* One-to-One Test Discussion after evaluation
* Topic-wise Notes provided before the schedule to help update existing notes
* Revision Lectures before each test, with doubt-solving
* Weekly One-to-One Mentorship with faculty, online or offline
* Hybrid Mode: Online + Offline
* Start Date: 14 September 2026
* Validity: Till 31 January 2027
* Only 40 Seats Available

Join LevelUp IAS PSIR Optional Telegram Group: https://t.me/PSIR_LevelupIAS
